reason: A DSH Web utility that adds a Ctrl+C keyboard shortcut to stop the active generation, while preserving copy behavior and optionally resuming queued messages.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加 Ctrl+C 快捷键，用于在生成过程中停止当前会话，并可按队列顺序继续处理待发送消息。
summaries.en: Adds a Ctrl+C shortcut to DSH Web for stopping the active generation and optionally resuming queued messages in order.

capabilities: Intercepts Ctrl+C in the DSH Web interface when no text is selected
Cancels the currently generating conversation turn
Requeues pending messages in FIFO order for automatic continuation
Reads and writes a localStorage setting controlling automatic resume
